messages:
marta.garcia: kicking off RC-20260405 (artifact: inference-service@4.2.0-rc3). tagging here for quiet window + telemetry handoff. please ack if you have any blockers.
release-bot: rc created: RC-20260405 by marta.garcia. Pin: inference-service@4.2.0-rc3. Change window: 2026-04-05 02:00-04:00 UTC. /release notes link: https://confluence/redwood/rc-20260405
nick: ack. I've queued the smoke tests and KV warm job.
anita: quick question — any DB migration in this RC? trying to decide if we need schema freeze.
marta.garcia: no schema changes. just runtime perf and routing fix. no migration.
sqa-lead: starting smoke now — will post results in 10m.
deploy-bot: canary plan created: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% (10min per step). auto-rollback thresholds: error-rate > 3% or latency p95 increase > 40%.
sheriff-ops: noting the deadman switch and timing. I'll be on-call during the window.
nick: KV warm kicked: job id kvw-8812. ETA ~7m.
release-bot: telemetry baseline snapshot captured: tb-654321. will compare canary metrics against this baseline.
sqa-lead: smoke: all green except a flaky /embed route (intermittent 504). low impact, investigating.
marta.garcia: keeping an eye. if embed error persists in canary, hold and escalate.
anita: any change in routing policy? planning to keep same model pinning?
marta.garcia: routing unchanged. model pinned to open-llama-7b-quantized for this RC.
deploy-bot: promote RC-20260405 to canary step 1 (5%). command run by marta.garcia: `/deploy promote RC-20260405 --to canary --pct 5`
deploy-bot: ✅ started canary (5%). rollout id: r-654321-1. Watchers: @sheriff-ops @nick @sqa-lead.
nick: tracing heatmap hooked. focusing on tail latencies.
sheriff-ops: telemetry handoff received. will watch errors and p95. set alert for error-rate > 2% (pre-alert) and 3% (abort).
release-bot: canary telemetry diff: error-rate +0.6%, latency p95 +12% — within guardrails.
sqa-lead: embed 504s disappeared after retry patch. smoke ok now.
anita: can we hold at 25% for longer than 10m? spike last time during second step.
marta.garcia: yes, hold for 20m at 25% to validate KV warm under steady traffic. plan: step2 to 25% now but tagged as extended.
deploy-bot: advancing to canary step 2 (25%). command: `/deploy promote RC-20260405 --to canary --pct 25 --hold 20m`
deploy-bot: ✅ canary at 25% (extended hold). rollout id: r-654321-2.
nick: seeing small p95 bump (~22%) on short queries, likely cold cache. monitoring.
sheriff-ops: pre-alert fired at error-rate 2.3% — investigating traces.
sqa-lead: traced most errors to a downstream timeout to reranker service, not core inference. opened ticket #INF-988.
marta.garcia: thanks. reranker team looped. if reranker doesn't recover in 10m we abort and roll back.
release-bot: reranker recovery noted at +8m. error-rate trending down to baseline.
deploy-bot: policy check: can advance to 50% if no abort signals. no abort commands recorded.
anita: giving sign-off for 50% from product side — ok to proceed.
sheriff-ops: I approve advancing. I will stay until final promotion.
deploy-bot: advancing to canary step 3 (50%). `/deploy promote RC-20260405 --to canary --pct 50`
deploy-bot: ✅ canary at 50%. rollout id: r-654321-3.
nick: after 50% steady, I'll run the backpressure and perf sweep scripts (script: `tools/scale_sweep.sh --rc RC-20260405`).
sqa-lead: running regression harness now against canary subset.
release-bot: telemetry: post-50% diff: error-rate +0.8%, latency p95 +18% — under abort thresholds. no QoR regressions.
marta.garcia: looks good. I'd like a final quick docs update (release notes minor callouts) before full promo.
anita: docs update is live in the release notes page.
sheriff-ops: green from ops. no pending alerts. recommend full promotion.
marta.garcia: final check: KV warm log shows steady hit-rate. nick confirm backpressure tests ok?
nick: pass. CPU/GPU utilization within expected range, no mem growth.
deploy-bot: scheduling final promotion to prod. hold for 5m to let extended checks finish. `/deploy schedule RC-20260405 --to prod --at now+5m`
release-bot: PROD promotion queued: pq-654321. Window still within 02:00-04:00 UTC.
(4m later)
release-bot: quick check: no outstanding blocking alerts.
marta.garcia: doing the sheriff handshake — @sheriff-ops you have the final abort authority.
sheriff-ops: acknowledged. abort if error-rate > 3% or latency p95 > 40% sustained 3m.
deploy-bot: executing promotion to prod (100%). `/deploy promote RC-20260405 --to prod --pct 100` initiated by marta.garcia.
deploy-bot: ✅ promotion started. rollout id: r-654321-final. will stream events here.
release-bot: release note snapshot finalized. link: https://confluence/redwood/rc-20260405#release-notes
(6m into prod rollout)
sheriff-ops: seeing transient p95 spike to +35% for ~2m — within abort threshold but not sustained. watching.
nick: correlation shows a small GC storm on a subset of nodes, scaling handled it. no mem leak.
sqa-lead: regression harness green against prod traffic sample.
release-bot: telemetry after 10m in prod: error-rate +0.9%, latency p95 +20%. within targets.
marta.garcia: promoting complete. tagging release as GA candidate. please file any post-promote followups in INF-989.
anita: thanks everyone. I'll update stakeholders and close the quiet window at 04:00 UTC.
sheriff-ops: handing back to oncall rotation at 04:15 UTC. leaving note in ops-runbook.
release-bot: RC-20260405 promotion complete by marta.garcia. Rollout id r-654321-final. If you need rollback, run: `/deploy rollback RC-20260405`.
marta.garcia: great job team :tada: — small postmortem if any anomalies in INF-989. closing thread.
